Core explanation · 00:00–04:59

In this session, we will small problems on Lagrange Method.

Key details

  • Find the dimensions of the rectangle box open at the top of maximum capacity whose surface is 432 square centimeter.
  • Two XY plus two Y Z plus two Z because the boxes open at the top.
  • Because we need to find out the dimensions that is XYZ of this rectangular box.
  • This volume xyz becomes function for the problem and xy plus 2yz plus 2 z equals 432 becomes constraint for the problem.
  • plus 2 zx minus 432 equals 0.
  • That is xy plus two yz plus two zx minus four thirty two.
  • Next, as per the procedure, we need to compute the partial derivative of f with respect to x, y, as well as z.
  • Then we equate fx to zero.
  • That leads to yz lambda of y plus two z equals zero.
  • of f with respect to y equals zero gives x plus lambda x plus two z equals zero.
  • We see that 2z lambda of x minus y equals 0.
  • Because 2z lambda is not zero, we can equate x minus y equals 0, then that gives x equals y.
  • Similarly, multiply 2 by y and 3 by z and subtracting we get x lambda of y minus 2 z t equals 0 because x lambda not zero we can equate y minus 2 z to 0 that gives y equal to 2 z.
  • Substitute x equals y, y equals to z in the constant and for you have x y z.
  • We see that.
  • 3x square equals 432 or x equals 12.
  • Because y is x, so y is 12.
  • Because z is y by 2, z becomes 6.
  • So this is how we can solve problem using Lagrange method.

Example or application from the lecture

  • So let's look at the first problem.
  • Let us use the grandiose function which is given by f of x y z equals f of x y z plus lambda times phi.

Core explanation · 05:00–09:59

Let's look at the second problem.

Key details

  • Divide the number 24 into three parts such that the continued product of the first square of the second and the cube of the third may be maximum.
  • Continued product means the product we get by multiplying together in succession.
  • Then divide the number 24 into three parts.
  • It means we want to split 24 into three non-negative parts.
  • X plus Y plus Z minus 24.
  • F to zero gives two x y z power three plus lambda zero.
  • Observe carefully in all these three expressions, we can use this idea.
  • In each case, lambda equals minus y square z power 3, minus 2x y z power 3, minus 3xy square z square.
  • We see that minus y square z power 3 and minus 2x y z power 3.
  • It means from the first two terms we can get y equals to 2x.
  • So because y is 2x, y becomes 8, and because z is 3x, z is 12.
  • It means the three parts are 4 and 8 and 12.
  • Because this is the only condition under which the inscribed rectangular solid achieves maximum volume inside the sphere.
  • And f z to 0, so we see that lambda equal to minus y z by 2x, lambda equal to minus x z by two y, lambda equals minus x by 2z.
  • When we solve all these in ratios, we see that x equals y equals a.

Example or application from the lecture

  • Before we solve this problem, let's understand what is the meaning of continued product.
  • It means if we have three parts, let us say x comma y comma z, then the continued product of the first square of the second and the cube of the third is going to be x times y square times z power three.
  • Let's say xyz, that is x plus y plus z equals 24.
